The '''Twilight Forest''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located between the [[Asou Dankal]], [[Takal Nax]] and [[Susk'kinad]] regions. Its landscape consisted mostly of plateaus and canyons. While the grassy plateaus were sparsely forested, the bottom of the canyons contained lush jungles. The Twilight Forest was the heart of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] territory during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; the [[Nightsister Stronghold]] was located there.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twilight Forest was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
